global_evidence_requirements: Exact run/task and user/operator authorization reference, timestamp, command/argv, environment, selected limits, and exit/result status.

Checkout HEAD plus dirty/untracked source manifest; relevant source, configuration, fixture, receiver manifest/fingerprint, actual model/weights and binary hashes. Never use package claims or stale observations as current identity.
Actual lease/grant/interlock receipt and process PID/start identity; start/end resource observations and physical quiescence/release proof for owned processes.
Nonzero case/inquiry/test counts, per-case outcome, citations/provenance, separate reasoning/prefill/tool/queue/foreground timings, and all omissions/uncertainty.
Keep scripted/source receipts, model inference, device computation, sandbox containment, and installed-release lifecycle as distinct evidence types.
non_claims: No fixture-only or source-only result may satisfy a live_model, live_gpu, sandbox, or installed-runtime lifecycle case.
No existing native CPU acceptance gate is automatically one of these 40 package cases.
No source-mode harness result establishes model usefulness, GPU performance, real resource exclusivity, biological validity, or production readiness.
No automatic feature activation, candidate promotion, or production deployment follows from this qualification record.
run_order: Re-fetch the live task/evidence authority as root; confirm scope and no conflict without changing Todo state from this child.
Capture current candidate identity and source/config/fixture/weights/binary/model hashes; distinguish tracked dirty and untracked input; defer if a race makes capture inconsistent.
Record bounded source/CPU preflight commands and results separately from acceptance-case outcomes; preserve failures and prior receipts without treating them as passes.
Verify the actual selected server/model and exclusive lease, foreground interlock, permissions, cache isolation, and owned-process accounting before first inference.
Run at most 12 initial comparison inquiries within 900 seconds and two parallel executions; count baseline and all retries/continuations.
If separately selected, run at most four held-out inquiries within 300 seconds after initial selection; preserve new fixture identity and do not tune on held-out labels.

If focus is opted in, run no more than two roots/12 turns/120 seconds as part of the initial inquiry budget, paired against equivalent foreground work; turn automatic mode off if any gate is unavailable or fails.

Execute only the applicable separately authorized lifecycle/GPU/sandbox cases within the 300-second non-inference lifecycle budget and approved resource grant; release all owned inference by 900 seconds warm residency.
Reconcile every effect and physical resource at completion; only then populate docs/pa1/acceptance-results.json from actual receipts.
